headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when there was a changing of the guard for the FTW Title as Ricky Starks vs. Brian Cage battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. Starks' first match back from a broken neck, and a betrayal within Team Taz ? Powerhouse Hobbs turned on Cage mid-match, clocking him with the title itself to hand Starks a shocking win, effectively ending Cage's time with the group.
Looking back to 2023, when Willow Nightingale vs. Athena met in a Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a well-worked match.

On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Darby Allin vs. Ethan Page settled things in a Coffin Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.84 ? a strong outing in a hard-fought men's division clash, on an outstanding Fyter Fest - Night 1 '21 show that earned an overall rating of 8.28.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2021, when the IWGP United States Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Karl Anderson went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.40. Karl Anderson was challenging for gold for the very first time.
2023 brought us this moment: it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Lance Archer returned to the ring after just under 8 months away, appearing on Rampage.
